presentation.presenting_problem: I’ve developed a fear of driving on motorways after having a panic attack while driving last year.
presentation.timeline: It started about 8 months ago after a very stressful period at work.
presentation.thoughts: I keep worrying that I might lose control of the car or cause an accident while driving.
presentation.feelings: I feel anxious, trapped, and panicked even thinking about driving on motorways.
presentation.physical: My chest feels tight, my hands sweat, and my heart starts racing when I approach motorways.
presentation.past: I had a panic attack in a supermarket a few years ago during another stressful period.
presentation.goal: I want to feel calm, safe, and confident when driving again.

persona.emotional_presentation: Anxious when discussing motorway driving and loss of control.

concerns: Will I still be in control during hypnosis?

training_challenges: establish relevant safety and healthcare history
simulation.hypnosis_question: Will I still be in control during hypnosis?

presentation.presenting_problem: I’ve been struggling with anxiety around my performance at work.
presentation.timeline: It really started after I was promoted last year and given more responsibility.
presentation.thoughts: I keep thinking I’m going to fail, make mistakes, or disappoint people.
presentation.feelings: I feel overwhelmed, pressured, and mentally exhausted most of the time.
presentation.physical: I get a heavy feeling in my chest and a lot of tension in my shoulders during work.
presentation.past: I’ve always put a lot of pressure on myself to succeed, even when I was younger.
presentation.goal: I want to feel calmer, more capable, and more confident in my role.

persona.emotional_presentation: Pressured, overwhelmed and mentally exhausted around work performance.
behavioural_tendencies: places substantial pressure on himself to succeed

concerns: How can hypnotherapy help with confidence?

motivation.why_now: Anxiety became significant after promotion and increased responsibility at work.

training_challenges: identify the maintaining mechanisms behind performance anxiety
explore the impact of increased responsibility
establish relevant safety and healthcare history
simulation.hypnosis_question: How can hypnotherapy help with confidence?

presentation.presenting_problem: It feels like everything becomes too loud and overwhelming when I’m in crowded places.
presentation.timeline: It’s been gradually building over the past couple of years.
presentation.thoughts: My mind starts spiralling when there’s too much activity or noise around me.
presentation.feelings: I feel overwhelmed, trapped, and like I need to escape busy environments.
presentation.physical: It feels like a wave rising in my chest and everything becomes too much physically and emotionally.
presentation.past: I remember feeling something similar at school when I felt judged or under pressure.
presentation.goal: I want to feel calmer and more in control in busy environments.

persona.emotional_presentation: Overwhelmed and trapped when exposed to busy or highly stimulating environments.

concerns: What does hypnosis actually feel like?

supporting_evidence: physical and emotional experience of anxiety

training_challenges: explore the sensory and emotional experience
explore earlier experiences without assuming causation
establish relevant safety and healthcare history
simulation.hypnosis_question: What does hypnosis actually feel like?

presentation.presenting_problem: I’ve been struggling with sleep and feeling anxious most nights.
presentation.timeline: It started during a stressful period at work about a year ago.
presentation.thoughts: At night my mind keeps going over everything that could go wrong and I can’t switch off.
presentation.feelings: I feel uneasy, mentally exhausted, and constantly on edge at night.
presentation.physical: My stomach feels tight, my body feels restless, and I find it hard to relax properly before sleep.
presentation.past: It reminds me of when I was younger and used to worry a lot about school and expectations.
presentation.goal: I want to be able to relax properly, switch off mentally, and sleep peacefully again.

persona.emotional_presentation: Mentally exhausted, uneasy and on edge when discussing sleep and night-time worry.

concerns: Can hypnosis help me quiet my mind at night?

contra_evidence: Regression should not be automatically selected solely because an earlier experience is mentioned.

training_challenges: avoid assuming that an earlier memory establishes causation
justify treatment selection from evidence rather than the historical reference alone
simulation.hypnosis_question: Can hypnosis help me quiet my mind at night?
